body.message:
Hello Vero,

Apologies for the delay.

As requested, please find the 3-month rates for a 2-bedroom apartment at Seaside Hills Residence, The Shores, Al Zorah, Ajman below:

October: AED 18,000
November: AED 21,000
December: AED 24,000

Please note that a security deposit of AED 2,000 is required.

The booking will be processed on a monthly basis, with each month calculated as 30 nights.

Please also note that the rates displayed online are applicable only for September. Rates may vary from month to month depending on availability and demand. The above rates are applicable to your requested dates.

To secure a 3-month booking, the first month’s rent, last month’s rent, and security deposit must be paid in advance. Once the payment is received, we can reserve the unit and secure the agreed rates for the confirmed booking period.

Thank you.
